title: Only the first wave of a cloud-submitted epic fans out to containers
description:
Found by the Phase 2 final review (oun), verified directly in run-workflow.ts rather than taken from the design doc. context.cloud_wave is computed ONCE at run start from params.tick_ids, and the closeout pass always runs through the unchanged Phase 1 single-sandbox supervisePass without re-deriving or re-dispatching a second cloud wave. So an epic needing more than one wave gets per-tick containers for the first wave only; everything after runs inside the closeout orchestrator sandbox as harness-substrate subagents.

Not a defect in what was built — b6e scoped it honestly — but an operator reading "Phase 2: cloud substrate fan-out" will reasonably assume every wave fans out, and the runs where it silently does not are exactly the long multi-wave epics where it matters most. Either re-derive the wave per pass, or say plainly in status and docs that fan-out is first-wave-only.
